arxiv-2104-12935.title: Topological quantum phase transitions of anisotropic AFM Kitaev model driven by magnetic field
arxiv-2104-12935.creator: Shi-Qing Jia, Ya-Min Quan, Liang-Jian Zou, Hai-Qing Lin
arxiv-2104-12935.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shi-Qing Jia, Ya-Min Quan, Liang-Jian Zou, Hai-Qing Lin. We investigate the evolution of quantum spin liquid states of anisotropic Kitaev model with the [ 001 ] [001] magnetic field by utilizing the finite-temperature Lanczos method (FTLM).

arxiv-2206-05022.title: A Fast Third-Step Second-Order Explicit Numerical Approach To Investigating and Forecasting The Dynamic of Corruption And Poverty In Cameroon
arxiv-2206-05022.creator: Eric Ngondiep
arxiv-2206-05022.description: Abstract Abstract. This paper constructs a third-step second-order numerical approach for solving a mathematical model on the dynamic of corruption and poverty. The stability and error estimates of the proposed technique are analyzed using the L^{2} -norm. The developed algorithm is at less zero-stable and second-order accurate.

arxiv-2211-06401.title: A Federated Approach to Predicting Emojis in Hindi Tweets
arxiv-2211-06401.creator: Deep Gandhi*, Jash Mehta*, Nirali Parekh, Karan Waghela, Lynette D’Mello, Zeerak Talat
arxiv-2211-06401.description: Abstract The use of emojis affords a visual modality to, often private, textual communication. The task of predicting emojis however provides a challenge for machine learning as emoji use tends to cluster into the frequently used and the rarely used emojis.

arxiv-2305-07440.title: Optimizing Memory Mapping Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2305-07440.creator: Pengming Wang, Mikita Sazanovich, Berkin Ilbeyi, Phitchaya Mangpo Phothilimthana, Manish Purohit, Han Yang Tay, Ngân Vũ, Miaosen Wang, Cosmin Paduraru, Edouard Leurent, Anton Zhernov, Po-Sen Huang, Julian Schrittwieser, Thomas Hubert, Robert Tung, Paula Kurylowicz, Kieran Milan, Oriol Vinyals, Danie
arxiv-2305-07440.description: Abstract Resource scheduling and allocation is a critical component of many high impact systems ranging from congestion control to cloud computing. Finding more optimal solutions to these problems often has significant impact on resource and time savings, reducing device wear-and-tear, and even potentially improving carbon emissions.

arxiv-2305-15858.title: LLHR: Low Latency and High Reliability CNN Distributed Inference for Resource-Constrained UAV Swarms
arxiv-2305-15858.creator: Marwan Dhuheir 1 , Aiman Erbad 1 , Sinan Sabeeh 2
arxiv-2305-15858.description: Abstract Recently, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have shown impressive performance in many critical applications, such as surveillance, search and rescue operations, environmental monitoring, etc. In many of these applications, the UAVs capture images as well as other sensory data and then send the data processing requests to remote servers.

arxiv-2307-08854.title: Fixed-Parameter Algorithms for Fair Hitting Set Problems
arxiv-2307-08854.creator: Tanmay Inamdar, Lawqueen Kanesh, Madhumita Kundu, Nidhi Purohit, Saket Saurabh
arxiv-2307-08854.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tanmay Inamdar, Lawqueen Kanesh, Madhumita Kundu, Nidhi Purohit, Saket Saurabh. Selection of a group of representatives satisfying certain fairness constraints, is a commonly occurring scenario. Motivated by this, we initiate a systematic algorithmic study of a fair version of Hitting Set . In the classical Hitting Set problem, the input is a universe 𝒰 \mathcal{U} , a family ℱ \mathcal{F} of subsets of 𝒰 \mathcal{U} , and a non-negative integer k k .

arxiv-2402-06843.title: All “roads” lead to rocksalt structure
arxiv-2402-06843.creator: Matthew Jankousky, Helen Chen, Andrew Novick, Vladan Stevanović
arxiv-2402-06843.description: Abstract Rocksalt is the most common crystal structure among binary compounds. Moreover, no long-lived, metastable polymorphs are observed in compounds with the rocksalt ground state. We investigate the absence of polymorphism and the dominance of the rocksalt structure via first-principles random structure sampling and transformation kinetics modeling of three rocksalt compounds: MgO, TaC, and PbTe.

arxiv-2510-19560.title: HAD: Hierarchical Asymmetric Distillation to Bridge Spatio-Temporal Gaps in Event-Based Object Tracking
arxiv-2510-19560.creator: Yao Deng, Xian Zhong, Wenxuan Liu, Zhaofei Yu, Jingling Yuan, and Tiejun Huang
arxiv-2510-19560.description: Abstract RGB cameras excel at capturing rich texture details with high spatial resolution, whereas event cameras offer exceptional temporal resolution and a high dynamic range (HDR). Leveraging their complementary strengths can substantially enhance object tracking under challenging conditions, such as high-speed motion, HDR environments, and dynamic background interference.

arxiv-2511-13413.title: Emulation of the Six-State Quantum Key Distribution Protocol with Pulsed Lasers
arxiv-2511-13413.creator: Sara P. Gandelman, Georgi Gary Rozenman
arxiv-2511-13413.description: Abstract Quantum cryptography remains a topic of enduring scientific and educational interest. Here, we present a clear and accessible framework for exploring the six-state quantum key distribution protocol—an enhanced, three-basis extension of the BB84 scheme—combining optical experiments with computational analysis.

arxiv-2602-14994.title: On the Semantics of Primary Cause in Hybrid Dynamic Domains Conference: Preprint; Saskatchewan; Canada
arxiv-2602-14994.creator: Shakil M. Khan, Asim Mehmood, Sandra Zilles
arxiv-2602-14994.description: Abstract . Reasoning about actual causes of observed effects is fundamental to the study of rationality. This important problem has been studied since the time of Aristotle, with formal mathematical accounts emerging recently. We live in a world where change due to actions can be both discrete and continuous, that is, hybrid.

arxiv-2605-08530.title: A Two-Stage Motion-Aware Framework for mmWave-based Human Mesh Recovery
arxiv-2605-08530.creator: Hoang Hai Pham, Shuntian Zheng, Jiaqi Li, Yu Guan

arxiv-2605-22567.title: Lang : Reinforcement Learning for Multilingual Reasoning with Language-Adaptive Hint Guidance
arxiv-2605-22567.creator: Yuchun Fan, Bei Li, Peiguang Li, Yilin Wang, Yongyu Mu, Jian Yang, Xin Chen, Rongxiang Weng, Jingang Wang, Xunliang Cai, Jingbo Zhu, Tong Xiao

pmc-10647534.title: Efficacy and Safety of Adalimumab Biosimilar GP2017 in Patients with Inflammatory Bowel Disease
pmc-10647534.creator: Marta Vernero, Cristina Bezzio, Davide G. Ribaldone, Stefania Costa, Davide Scalvini, Elisa Tribocco, Gianpiero Manes, Simone Saibeni
pmc-10647534.description: (1) Background: GP2017 is one of the biosimilar drugs of adalimumab, one of the anti-TNF agents used for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). To date, there is little real-world data about the use of GP2017 in IBD patients. The aim of our study was to evaluate the effectiveness and safety of this biosimilar in an IBD population.

pmc-11310275.title: Loss over 5% of chromosome 1p is a clinically relevant and applicable cut-off for increased risk of recurrence in meningioma
pmc-11310275.creator: Sybren L. N. Maas, Thomas Hielscher, Philipp Sievers, Volker Hovestadt, Abigail K. Suwala, Till Acker, Michael Weller, Matthias Preusser, Christel Herold-Mende, Wolfgang Wick, Andreas von Deimling, Natalie Berghaus, Felix Sahm
pmc-11310275.description: mal arm that harbors the NF2-gene [2, 7, 10, 11]. Other frequent CNVs include losses in 1p, 6p/q, 10q, 14q and 18p/q. Investigations into the temporal order of CNVs, identified 1p loss as the first CNV after 22q loss [7, 8].

pmc-11318341.title: Diagnosis of human angiostrongyliasis in a case of hydrocephalus using next-generation sequencing: a case report and literature review
pmc-11318341.creator: Dayuan Liu, Ning Li, Yubo Zhu, Qianhua Chen, Xudong Fan, Jigao Feng
pmc-11318341.description: BackgroundAngiostrongyliasis cantonensis is a severe yet rare parasitic infection caused by the larvae of Angiostrongylus cantonensis. The primary characteristic feature of this foodborne illness in humans is eosinophilic meningitis. Recently, there has been a gradual increase in reported cases globally.

pmc-11530921.title: Protocol for detection of glial complement expression in relation to amyloid plaques in mouse brain with combined FISH and IHC
pmc-11530921.creator: Sadhna Rao, Joanna Yung, Melissa Gonzalez Edick, Jesse E Hanson
pmc-11530921.description: SummaryComplement proteins contribute to neurodegeneration in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and are secreted by glia surrounding beta-amyloid (Aβ) plaques. We present an optimized protocol for Aβ plaque detection with tyramide-digoxigenin signal amplification. This is combined with a multiplex mRNA fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) panel to assay glial-specific complement expression proximal to Aβ plaques in TauPS2APP mice.

pmc-11546933.title: Harmful Effects on the Hippocampal Morpho-Histology and on Learning and Memory in the Offspring of Rats with Streptozotocin-Induced Diabetes
pmc-11546933.creator: Marcela Salazar-García, Laura Villavicencio-Guzmán, Cristina Revilla-Monsalve, Carlos César Patiño-Morales, Ricardo Jaime-Cruz, Tania Cristina Ramírez-Fuentes, Juan Carlos Corona, Davide Maggi, Alessandra Puddu
pmc-11546933.description: Learning alterations in the child population may be linked to gestational diabetes as a causal factor, though this remains an open and highly controversial question. In that sense, it has been reported that maternal hyperglycemia generates a threatening condition that affects hippocampal development in offspring.

pmc-11710356.title: Association of Sleeping Pills on Anxiety Symptoms in Dementia and Borderline Groups: Insights from the 2022 National Health and Aging Trends Study
pmc-11710356.creator: Sanghee Yoo, Ickpyo Hong
pmc-11710356.description: BackgroundOld adults' sleep patterns change during the aging process1. Among old adults, 40% of individuals experience insufficient sleep and complain of sleeping disorder, including a decline in the quality of sleep2. Patients with dementia also experience sleep disorders, and the most common intervention for this is pharmacotherapy3,4.

pmc-12590630.title: Effects of prenatal bifidobacterium supplementation on the gut microbiome in preterm infants of preeclamptic mothers
pmc-12590630.creator: Linlin Yin, Jing Zhao, Zhiping Zhou, Jun Zhang, Xiaoli Qu, Jie Shi, Feng Yin
pmc-12590630.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThis study examined the relationship between maternal preeclampsia (PE) and gut microbiota colonization in preterm infants and analyzed the effects of prenatal Bifidobacterium supplementation.MethodsThis observational study included 45 preterm infants categorized according to their mothers’ exposure status during pregnancy.

pmc-12694107.title: Mechanism of Pipeline Leakage Sound Generation and Leak Detection Technology Under Multiple Operational Conditions
pmc-12694107.creator: Fei Chen, Taikeng Jiang, Latao Jiang, Chen Rong, Xiaohang Li, Liang Chen, Xuefei Xu, Jin Yang
pmc-12694107.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Acoustic emission detection technology is widely employed for leakage detection in water supply systems. However, this approach heavily relies on extensive field data to develop feature extraction and analysis models. Since field data cannot comprehensively cover all operational conditions—such as variations in pressure, pipe diameter, and leakage size—the limited generalization capability of these models often results in high rates of false negatives and false positives.

pmc-13000390.title: Validation of the Korean version of the Self-Dehumanization Scale
pmc-13000390.creator: Khongorzul Khosbayar, Jang-won Seo
pmc-13000390.description: IntroductionSelf-dehumanization refers to the perception of oneself as less human, and it has been closely associated with psychological difficulties such as depression, suicidal ideation, and self-hatred. The Self-Dehumanization Scale (SDS) was developed to assess animalistic and mechanistic forms of self-dehumanization.MethodThis study aimed to translate and validate a Korean version of the SDS (K-SDS) in an adult sample.

pmc-13618797.title: Complementary roles of virtual and real trials in medicine: An interplay of virtuous spirals
pmc-13618797.creator: Ehsan Samei, Liesbeth Vancoillie, Michael Wilde, Alejandro F Frangi, Ehsan Abadi, Predrag R Bakic, Kristina Bliznakova, Hilde Bosmans, Ann-Katherine Carton, Dimitra G Darambara, Paul Kinahan, Mojtaba Lashgari, Rie Tanaka, Hongkai Wang, Arezoo Zakeri, Handling Editor
pmc-13618797.description: Virtual trials provide medical knowledge and practical methods for generating evidence through computational methods. But extending beyond those advantages, they offer epistemic opportunities to add mechanistic explainability to predictive inference of real trials. Relating the distinct contributions and ontology of virtual and real trials enables a transformative convergence of biological and clinical insights that they embody.

pmc-13663913.title: Triokinase/FMN Cyclase: A Bifunctional Enzyme Linking Metabolism, Stress Responses and Disease
pmc-13663913.creator: João Meireles Ribeiro, Fernando Martín-Ruiz, José Carlos Cameselle
pmc-13663913.description: Simple SummaryTriokinase/flavin mononucleotide cyclase is an unusual human enzyme with two very different activities. This protein was first studied because it helps the body use fructose. We now know that its role is much broader. This review explains how it works, how its two activities are connected, and where it acts in the body.
